value.signature: async fn tips (& mut self , scope : & EpochScope , after : Option < Identity > , limit : usize) -> Result < Page , Error >

review.body: { let result = async { let candidates = self . candidates (scope , after , limit) . await ? ; let mut page = Page { identities : Vec :: new () , after : candidates . after , end : candidates . end , } ; self . meter . reserve (& mut page . identities , candidates . identities . len ()) ? ; for identity in candidates . identities { if ! self . has_child (scope , identity) . await ? { page . identities . push (identity) ; } } Ok (page) } . await ; self . record (& result) ; result }
review.item_premise: The bounded server reader retains the existing protected Session and read-only transaction. Closed statements deliver only bounded public metadata and canonical retained evidence; all variable projections carry their stored lengths. The shared allowance admits delivery reservations, strict-validator requests and reconstruction before execution. Returned owned bytes and origins grant no admitted capability. Session configuration, cancellation and diagnostics retain their existing carriers; no new secret exit or transport path is introduced. Operation observation is outside reconstruction accounting. The reader records its first local refusal for its consuming end; individual read results, delivery reservations and retained bytes are unchanged.
